summary: Parks! America, Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting that its wholly owned subsidiary Wild Animal Safari, Inc. entered a $1.30 million term loan credit agreement with Cendera Bank dated August 26, 2026, fully repaying prior Synovus Bank debt from June 18, 2021. The loan matures September 1, 2033, with seven-year term and 25-year amortization, balloon due at maturity. A SouthState/ARC Rate Conversion Agreement fixed the rate at 7.35% versus initial SOFR-plus-2.70% (6.37%). Guaranteed by the parent, secured by substantially all subsidiary assets, minimum 1.20x DSCR covenant; approximately $39,000 fees.
